coverage.target: No cloud infrastructure; UI responsiveness achieved by Android/Compose app runtime and coroutine-off-main-thread design. Verified by :app:testDebugUnitTest and debug smoke/ANR observation (cicd-pipeline.md, monitoring-design.md).

No cloud infrastructure; grocery list performance handled by Compose LazyColumn/state design and Gradle app build. Verified by representative fixture sanity/manual test and unit tests (cicd-pipeline.md).
No cloud infrastructure; navigation/context/focus preserved in app navigation/state. Verified by navigation/state tests and manual focus/TalkBack checks (cicd-pipeline.md, monitoring-design.md).
App-level loading/empty/error/fallback/R-05 states required; CI/manual smoke gates verify next actions; no cloud monitoring stack provisioned (monitoring-design.md, cicd-pipeline.md).
No backend/account/cloud identity infrastructure provisioned; app routes/state contain no auth/account. Verified by review/tests (infrastructure-specification.md, cicd-pipeline.md).
Accessibility/missing-data/non-medical/privacy-safe label checks included in CI/manual smoke and review gates (monitoring-design.md, cicd-pipeline.md).

Android runtime permission platform boundary used; no cloud permission service. Manual store selection always available; verified by fake permission tests/manual checks (infrastructure-specification.md, cicd-pipeline.md).

No secrets/raw GPS/PII in source, UI state, or diagnostics hooks; secrets kept outside VCS/CI secure stores if ever needed. Verified by review/tests (infrastructure-specification.md, monitoring-design.md, cicd-pipeline.md).

Export uses Android share/copy platform boundaries with explicit user action and mandatory fallback; official S-ostoslista investigational, no cloud export infra provisioned (infrastructure-specification.md, cicd-pipeline.md).
Presence UI constrained to name/presence only via app/domain contracts; no PRISMA stock infrastructure provisioned. Verified by state/copy tests and review (monitoring-design.md, cicd-pipeline.md).
